extraction.notes: Three months ended September 30, 2022 column used. The FFO/Core/AFFO reconciliation starts from net loss of $(599), while the Financial Summary shows net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(597); the reconciliation figure was used as the starting line. Zero-valued lines (—) are included as printed. Per-share checks: 24,526/25,598 = 0.96; 21,842/25,598 = 0.85; 24,310/25,598 = 0.95. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so the Q3 2022 recurring capitalized maintenance figure ($3,943K) from the Historical Capital Expenditures table is reported in recurring_capex_disclosed. The table does not explicitly state its scope; it is treated as company total.
